versions.content: When a write job is finished successfully, the Eep module shall set the EEPROM state to MEMIF_IDLE and shall set the job result to MEMIF_JOB_OK. If configured, the Eep module shall call the notification defined in the configuration parameter EepJobEndNotification.

When a write job is finished successfully, the Eep module shall set the EEPROM state to MEMIF_IDLE and shall set the job result to 1 This feature is not mandatory but it depends on the EEPROM hardware manufacturer specification MEMIF_JOB_OK. If configured, the Eep module shall call the notification defined in the configuration parameter EepJobEndNotification.
